title: Egyptian Fish Fry
description: A crispy fried fish dish from Egypt, perfect for a quick lunch. Enjoy the flavors of the Mediterranean in this easy-to-make recipe.
instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, cornstarch, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
3. Dust the snapper fillets with the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
4. Fry the snapper fillets for 3-4 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
5. Remove the fish from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
6. Serve the fish hot with a squeeze of lemon juice and a side of your favorite vegetables.
